title: UK University Admissions Fair
content:
Representatives from fourteen UK universities, on-the-spot assessment of your transcript, and application fee waivers for offers made on the day.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.

title: Canada Study Permit Workshop
content:
A working session on financial documentation and the Student Direct Stream. Bring your bank statements — we review them individually in the second half.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.

title: Free IELTS Mock Test
content:
A full four-skill mock under exam conditions, with individual band feedback the following week. Seats are limited to twenty-four.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.

title: Scholarship Application Clinic
content:
Chevening, Commonwealth and DAAD, covered in sequence, with a live review of draft statements submitted in advance.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.

title: Australia and New Zealand Information Evening
content:
Post-study work rights, regional loading, and what the February intake timeline actually looks like from Dhaka.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.

title: Pre-Departure Briefing — September Intake
content:
For students already holding a visa. Accommodation, banking, packing, and what to expect in the first fortnight. Parents are welcome and usually find it more useful than students.

Registration is free and seats are allocated in order. If you cannot attend in person, tell us when you register and we will send the materials afterwards.
